text: This report recommends the 2026 meeting schedule for the Sign Variance Committee. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council's approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Approved the following 2026 meeting dates: Friday, February 6, 2026; Friday, March 13, 2026; Friday, May 15, 2026; Friday, June 19, 2026; Friday, September 18, 2026; Friday, October 23, 2026; and Friday, November 27, 2026.
